definition: [ID] Repository identifier in owner/repo form (GitHub Search API: full_name). One row per repository.
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [ID] Public URL of the repository (GitHub Search API: html_url).
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Audit] Time the repository row was built by scrape.py.
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Sampling] Language, stars band and creation period of the search query that found the repository, e.g. Python|50-499|pre2020. Not a model feature.
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Audit] Exact Search API query that found the repository.
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Feature, current value, rarely changes] Primary language detected by GitHub (API: language).
missing_treatment: blank when GitHub detects none; recode to Unknown
transform: group rare languages into Other; one-hot encode if used in a model

definition: [Feature, current value, rarely changes] Detected license (API: license.spdx_id), e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, NOASSERTION.
missing_treatment: blank means no license detected; recode to None
transform: group rare licenses into Other; one-hot encode if used in a model

definition: [Feature, current value] 1 if the owner is an Organization, 0 if a User (API: owner.type).
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Audit flag, post-T, not a feature] 1 if the repository is archived at collection time. Kept so archived repositories are reported, not predicted from.
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Metadata] Repository creation time (API: created_at); used to derive repo_age_days_at_T.
missing_treatment: never missing
transform: converted to repo_age_days_at_T; dropped from cleaned data

definition: [Feature, pre-T] Cutoff T (2024-01-01) minus created_at. Greater than 365 by the sampling rule.
missing_treatment: never missing

definition: [Sampling only, never a feature, post-T] Star count at collection time (API: stargazers_count). Used to stratify the search and audit the sample; using it as a predictor would leak post-cutoff information.
missing_treatment: never missing
transform: dropped before modeling; log1p allowed in EDA only

definition: [Feature, pre-T] Non-bot commits in [2023-01-01, 2024-01-01). At most 500 raw commits are read per window.
missing_treatment: blank only for excluded rows, which are removed in cleaning

definition: [Feature, core, pre-T] Share of pre-window human commits made by the most active author.
missing_treatment: blank only for excluded rows, which are removed in cleaning

definition: [Feature, core, pre-T] Fewest authors whose commits together reach at least 50% of pre-window human commits.
missing_treatment: blank only for excluded rows, which are removed in cleaning
transform: standardize; also grouped as 1, 2, 3+ for EDA

definition: [Feature, pre-T] Distinct human authors in the pre-window. Aliases and unlinked e-mails can inflate it.
missing_treatment: blank only for excluded rows, which are removed in cleaning

definition: [Feature, pre-T] Days from the newest pre-window human commit to T.
missing_treatment: blank only for excluded rows, which are removed in cleaning

definition: [Quality flag, pre-T] 1 if the page cap was reached, so concentration is computed from the newest commits only.
missing_treatment: blank only for excluded rows
transform: none; used for a sensitivity check that drops capped repositories

definition: [Feature, pre-T] 1 if .github/workflows existed at the newest pre-T commit. GitHub Actions only; other CI systems are not detected.
missing_treatment: blank if the API call failed; drop or impute and report which

definition: [Label component, post-T, never a feature] Non-bot commits in [2024-01-01, 2024-06-29).
missing_treatment: blank for rows excluded before label collection

definition: [Quality flag, post-T] 1 if the page cap was reached in the label window.
missing_treatment: blank for rows excluded before label collection

definition: [EDA only, post-T, never a feature] Days from T to the first human commit in the label window.
missing_treatment: blank when there is no post-T human commit (decayed repositories); leave blank

definition: [Target, post-T] 1 if there are zero human commits in [2024-01-01, 2024-06-29), else 0. A proxy for inactivity, not for breakage.
missing_treatment: blank for rows excluded before label collection; such rows are removed in cleaning

definition: [Sensitivity label, post-T, never a feature] 1 if fewer than 5 human commits in the 180-day window.
missing_treatment: blank for rows excluded before label collection

definition: [Sensitivity label, post-T, never a feature] 1 if zero human commits in the first 90 days after T.
missing_treatment: blank if an API call failed; excluded from that sensitivity run

definition: [Sensitivity label, post-T, never a feature] 1 if zero human commits in the first 365 days after T.
missing_treatment: blank if an API call failed; excluded from that sensitivity run

definition: [Bookkeeping] 1 if the row passes all eligibility rules (non-fork, not tutorial-like, at least 5 pre-window human commits, no API errors).
missing_treatment: never missing
transform: cleaned data keeps only eligible = 1; column then dropped

definition: [Bookkeeping] Why a row is not eligible: fork_or_template, tutorial_like, pre_commits_below_3, pre_commits_below_5 or api_error_*. Blank when eligible.
missing_treatment: blank when eligible
